Hi there 👋, I'm Dylan.

I'm an independent [AI consultant](https://iwanalabs.com) and have been working in the AI & ML space for the [past decade](https://linkedin.com/in/dylanjcastillo). I've delivered projects for startups, large corporations, and government agencies. I also enjoy working on [open-source projects](https://github.com/dylanjcastillo).

This is my blog. I usually write about technical topics, but every once in a while I publish posts about financial independence or my end-of-year reviews.

If you'd like me to send you an email when I write new posts, you can [subscribe to my newsletter](https://subscribe.dylancastillo.co).

## Posts

These are longer posts covering mostly technical topics and a few personal posts such as yearly reviews.

:::{#posts}

## Today I Learned (TIL)

I’ve always liked [Simon Willison's "TIL" posts](https://til.simonwillison.net/), so I decided to borrow the idea.

This is where I’ll share small things I learn along the way. Nothing too polished or elaborate. Just things I found useful and thought someone else might too.

:::{#today-i-learned}
